races.name: PricedUp Bet 'National Hunt' Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)

verdicts.rp: by Andrew Sheret: A few promising types here but COOLTOBECARELESS still very much stands out.

races.name: William Hill Challenge Series Handicap Chase
races.going: Good-good to yielding in places on hurdle course

verdicts.rp: by Alan Sweetman: A good run at Fairyhouse last time gives EVERYSTEP OFTHEWAY a realistic chance despite the slight drawback of being 3lb wrong.

races.name: PricedUp Now With Best Odds Handicap Hurdle

verdicts.rp: by Andrew Sheret: The vote goes to MIDNIGHT BELLA whose handicap debut second in March is solid and she can probably be forgiven her unseat on return.

races.name: Denise Smith Memorial Novices' Limited Handicap Hurdle

verdicts.rp: by Alistair Jones: A chance is taken on MAKINBECON , a dual winner this year who had excuses when only 13-2 for his first run back from wind surgery.

races.name: Connolly's RED MILLS Irish EBF Auction & Median Maiden Hurdle
races.going: Good-good to yielding in places on hurdle course

verdicts.rp: by Tyrone Molloy: With 10l to spare over Give It A Crack in a Galway maiden hurdle last time, point winner MISSOURI SNOW can confirm that form.

races.name: Aubrey Bealby ABH Tipster Champion Novices' Handicap Chase

verdicts.rp: by Andrew Sheret: The suggestion is returning Olly Murphy chase newcomer NATUS VINCERE , the winner of her sole point.

races.name: Mark Sheasby Birthday Celebration Mares' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)

verdicts.rp: by Steve Boow: Hurdles debutante ASHBURTON is particularly interesting at this level with improvement on the cards. Western Charm is second pick.

races.name: Horse And Jockey 3-Y-O Maiden Hurdle
races.going: Good-good to yielding in places on hurdle course

verdicts.rp: by Tyrone Molloy: Neria is respected on debut for Willie Mullins but SUNRUSH can build on his encouraging recent hurdling debut to score.

races.name: Stables Business Park Handicap Hurdle

verdicts.rp: by Alistair Jones: A happier horse back over hurdles, ELECTRIC EDDY (nap) should be bang there with a repeat of his latest run in a higher grade.

races.name: PricedUp Boosts And BOG Handicap Hurdle

verdicts.rp: by Andrew Sheret: Diamond Geezer should go well with Troy Walsh taking 10lb off but narrow preference is for FRISKY WHISKEY.

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mares Maiden Hurdle
races.going: Good-good to yielding in places on hurdle course

verdicts.rp: by Tyrone Molloy: Though DIVABORIVA has shown her best hurdles form over further, she was third in a Grade 3 bumper over this trip so should cope.

races.name: PricedUp Bet Handicap Chase

verdicts.rp: by Peter Entwistle: Tom Gretton's JUKEBOX D'EDDY (nap) enjoyed an excellent time of it last season once fitted with a visor and can make a winning return.

races.name: Get Raceday Ready Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)

verdicts.rp: by Steve Boow: Grade 2 bumper winner FORTHFACTOR is taken to defy a penalty in this second attempt over hurdles. Milou Du Chenet is feared most.

races.name: Racing Here Again On 3rd December Maiden Hurdle
races.going: Good-good to yielding in places on hurdle course

verdicts.rp: by Tyrone Molloy: Malte De Solzen and MOMENT OF GRACE(nap) make most appeal even though they are returning off absences. The latter can edge it.

races.name: PricedUp Now With Best Odds Open NH Flat Race (GBB Race)

verdicts.rp: by Andrew Sheret: Plenty of potential in a concluding bumper where a tentative vote goes to Olly Murphy's Irish point recruit MONJEU DE CHAILLAC.

races.name: William Hill Challenge Series Mares Handicap Hurdle (0-100)
races.going: Good-good to yielding in places on hurdle course

verdicts.rp: by Alan Sweetman: It could pay to take an each-way chance on WALK ON ANNILOG who should be better for her run here two weeks ago.
